description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Dto' namespace. The class extends 'FilterParams' and includes properties and methods related to search filter parameters for supervisor evaluations, specifically a review ID and self-evaluation flag.
